name: July Birthday Party Comments Event
description: The July Birthday Party event has begun! There are a total of 9 characters celebrating their birthdays this month: Barbara, Kaveh, Kujou Sara, Hu Tao, Tartaglia, Shikanoin Heizou, Klee, Kuki Shinobu, and Yanfei. On characters' birthdays, yours truly will post a question here related to the birthday character. Travelers that answer correctly by leaving a message in the comments section will have a chance to win a merchandise prize!
